code='''from collections import deque\ndef transform(grid):\n h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[r[:] for r in grid]\n for y in range(h):\n  for x in range(w):\n   if grid[y][x]==0 or (y,x) in seen: continue\n   q=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); cells=[]\n   for a,b in q:\n    cells.append((a,b))\n    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):\n     c,d=a+da,b+db\n     if 0<=c<h and 0<=d<w and grid[c][d]!=0 and (c,d) not in seen: seen.add((c,d)); q.append((c,d))\n   colors=set(grid[a][b] for a,b in cells)\n   def area(col):\n    ps=[(a,b) for a,b in cells if grid[a][b]==col]\n    return (max(a for a,b in ps)-min(a for a,b in ps)+1)*(max(b for a,b in ps)-min(b for a,b in ps)+1)\n   order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:area(c),reverse=True)\n   mp={c:order[-1-i] for i,c in enumerate(order)}\n   for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=mp[grid[a][b]]\n return out\n'''
